answer: Self‑attention requires only a constant number of sequential operations ( O(1) ) and its longest information‑propagation path between any two positions is also constant ( O(1) ) [Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, PDF p. 6]. In contrast, a recurrent layer needs a number of sequential steps that grows linearly with the sequence length ( O(n) ) and its maximum path length is likewise linear in n ( O(n) ) [Attention Is All You Need, arXiv:1706.03762v7, PDF p. 6].
